_readme: Generated stills (B-roll plates, abstract backgrounds, mockups). Copy to ai/images.json, then: node ../../tools/fal/generate-images.mjs --project . --dry. flux: cheap and fast (size presets or {width,height}); pro: Nano Banana Pro for text/brand mockups (aspect + resolution). Outputs: ai/images/<id>.png. Label as AI-generated when shown as if real.
